ip_address.description: IP address of the user initiating the OutboundPayment. Set if `present` is set to `true`. IP address collection is required for risk and compliance reasons. This will be used to help determine if the OutboundPayment is authorized or should be blocked.

present.description: `true` if the OutboundPayment creation request is being made on behalf of an end user by a platform. Otherwise, `false`.
